subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this exact grouped set of third-party Action revisions across credentialed security, agent, and release workflows after the final rebased head passes required checks?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness defect, but accepting new executable third-party code at secret-bearing and publishing boundaries is an ownership decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Approve exact pins after checks
options.body: Accept the grouped update once an owner verifies the official upstream revisions and all required checks pass on the final rebased SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive action groups
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates into narrower PRs if maintainers want independent review and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve exact pins after checks
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update once an owner verifies the official upstream revisions and all required checks pass on the final rebased SHA.
